prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity, flat website design mockup for SkillSwap, a college peer skill-exchange and time-banking marketplace. This is a screen design, not a poster or photograph of a device. Follow the Superprof-inspired direction: huge approachable bold rounded sans-serif headlines, warm white #FFFCFA background, pale coral #FFF0ED search area, deep coral #C83B46 buttons, near-black #252326 text, spacious layout, rounded cards. Initials avatars only, no people or photos. No monetary prices, testimonials, invented certifications, inflated statistics, hearts/favourites, chat, or video-call controls. Names and descriptions are synthetic illustrative UI content. Real accessible UI must later replace raster text. Render precise readable text and practical controls. Brand text exactly "SkillSwap". Asset: mobile homepage only, portrait viewport 390 by 1000, edge-to-edge screen content without device frame, not a landscape board. Top navigation logo SkillSwap and accessible menu icon. Bold left-aligned headline "Learn something new.
Share what you know." and compact supportive description "Your time is your currency." Pale coral rounded search section with three vertically stacked full-width controls: input "What do you want to learn?", mode "Online", coral button "Find a skill". Horizontal subject links below for Programming, Music, Languages. Section "Meet your next learning partner". One full-width realistic card with a restrained pale yellow initials panel AS, "Ananya Shah", "Python", "Online · Programming", short description "Build your Python confidence, one concept at a time.", "No reviews yet", and "View profile". Bottom shows the beginning of "Teach. Earn minutes. Learn." Keep font sizes genuinely legible at phone width, clear margin 20px, no duplicated nav links, no multi-column miniature desktop layout, no fixed price, no review stars when there are no reviews.
